hypothesis: Positive source error alignment can change OD reliability even at equal perturbation amplitude.
design: Use the same seeded exchange in both scenarios. Cap it for feasibility under both signs in both source priors. Compare (+,+), (-,-), (+,-), and (-,+) at equal realized target movement for both rules and the clean controls. Average antipodes within each alignment group.
scope: Reused synthetic development cases. No hidden OD evaluation.
